thread:
Samir Desai: Heads-up — VerdiMart (pilot) dropped to ~30% of prior weekly requests. Renewal in 3 weeks. Procurement says they're doing a two-vendor bake-off; new ML lead joined last month. Can we triage risk and propose a 2-week recovery plan?

Noelle Chen: Yikes. Do we have a timeline of call volume and any thumbprint errors?

Samir Desai: Quick nightly rollup: 
```\nweek_t0_calls: 9,400\nweek_t1_calls: 2,900\nerror_rate_t1: 1.8% (was 0.6%)\nactive_routes_down: 2/8\n```
No infra deploys from our side in the window. Customer notes they toggled a low-latency mode to cut costs.

Kai Moreno: Support ticket #4789 shows a spike in `rate_limit` and `invalid_kv_token` after their client upgraded SDK. Also a few `partial_response` events when prompt length exceeded their client-side truncate. I repro'd with their sample prompt and saw p95 jump to 1.1s for long flows.

Liam O'Connor: I pulled their top 5 flows — majority are multi-turn product Q&A. They moved from batching size 16 -> 2 in the client config (likely to reduce tail latency but killed throughput).

Noelle Chen: Two parallel asks: 1) Quick outreach to the new ML lead to understand evaluation metrics (latency SLO vs cost/cost-per-1000 tokens vs accuracy). 2) Offer a focused recovery sprint: one-week infra triage + one-week app tuning workshop. Propose a Dedicated trial for their top route if cost/latency is the blocker.

Samir Desai: I'll message the ML lead. Draft: "Hi — Samir from Redwood CS. Noticed usage drop during your SDK upgrade. Can we do a 30min triage this week? We'll bring a perf sketch and recommended client settings." OK?

Noelle Chen: Perfect. Add suggested slots Wed 11am PT / Thu 3pm PT.

Kai Moreno: I'll prep a short repro harness and a golden config: async batching enabled, max_batch_size: 16, kv_prefix_cache: true. Also a brief example diff to change client flags.

Samir Desai: Posting outreach now.

ops-bot: notice: scheduler v1.9 deployed at 2060013000 — unrelated but logging.

Noelle Chen: Internal playbook for call:
- 5m: confirm evaluation criteria (p50/p95, token budget, quality)
- 10m: share quick perf numbers (before/after) + cost sketch
- 10m: propose 48hr client patch (batch+cache) and Dedicated trial option
- 5m: next steps / owners

Liam O'Connor: Infra note: we can simulate their traffic shape and show batching uplift. I can run a synthetic with their top prompts and paste before/after CSV. Quick SQL I ran: 
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls, avg(latency_ms) as avg_lat FROM request_logs
WHERE customer_id='verdimart' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 5;
```

Kai Moreno: Good. I prepared a 6-slide audit: summary, top-errors, golden config, cost delta, Dedicated trial proposal, and next steps.

Samir Desai: Outreach reply: "Can do Wed 11am PT. We're evaluating StreamFast + Redwood." They asked if we can show p95 and token spend deltas. Booked Wed 11am PT tentative.

Noelle Chen: Action owners: Samir (customer outreach + renewal timeline), Kai (golden config + slides), Liam (synthetic run + error triage). AE to be looped if procurement shows up.

Kai Moreno: Ran synthetic: enabling async batching + kv cache reduced p95 by ~320ms and increased throughput by 3.2x in our test harness. I'll attach the before/after numbers in the deck.

Liam O'Connor: Support update: fixed `invalid_kv_token` root cause — their token rotation script created stale keys. Sent a patch suggestion and a short debugging snippet to their eng.

Noelle Chen: Great. For the Wed call, let's offer two immediate options: 1) quick client patch (48-72h) to recover throughput; 2) 30-day dedicated trial on 1 hot route (fastest path to show steady p95). If they request pricing, defer to AE.

Samir Desai: Customer confirmed Wed 11am PT. I'll loop AE and send calendar invite.

Kai Moreno: Deck uploaded to #cs-assets and linked in invite.

ops-bot: heartbeat: quota monitor flagged VerdiMart for sudden quota drop at 2060014100.

Noelle Chen: Thanks team. After Wed we'll decide whether to extend pilot or propose Dedicated pilot. Will update this thread with outcomes. :thumbsup:
